findings.message: `defmt` was removed from the crate's default features, so by default `partition_manager::Error` no longer derives `defmt::Format`. This is a breaking public API change that has nothing to do with adding PartitionGuard. A downstream firmware crate that depends on `partition-manager` with default features and logs the error with `defmt::error!("{}", err)` (or puts `Error<E>` inside its own `#[derive(defmt::Format)]` type) stops compiling after this change with `Error<E>: defmt::Format` not satisfied. The change seems to have been made only so `cargo test` builds on the host; it should be handled in test/dev configuration instead of by changing the defaults.
